meta.promptText: India mein acne wali skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar konsa serum kharidun?

response.text:

Salicylic acid ke saath cica, isliye acne ke saath irritation/dryness concern ho to consider kar sakte ho.

**Agar main sirf ek choose karun:** 👉 **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid.**

**Use kaise karein:** raat ko clean, dry face par 2–3 drops, initially **week mein 2–3 baar**. Moisturizer zaroor lagana, aur daytime mein SPF 30+ sunscreen. Ek saath multiple strong actives mat lagana.

Agar tum mujhe bata do **skin oily/dry/combination hai aur pimples active hain ya mostly acne marks**, toh main ₹700 ke andar **exactly 1 serum** recommend kar dunga.
